top_signals.title: GE Vernova Expands in High-Voltage Grid Gear With Trench Deal
top_signals.summary: GE Vernova is buying high-voltage equipment maker Trench Group from Triton Partners for $9 billion and raised its 2026 revenue forecast for the third straight time on Wednesday. The company now expects revenue of $46.5 billion to $47.5 billion this year, up from the $45.5-$46.5 billion in its July guidance. Trench makes high-voltage grid equipment, and utilities are spending more on grids to replace aging infrastructure and meet demand from data centers and industrial electrification.
